engineering_revision: v01 counted UNKNOWN responses as answered coverage. v02 corrects the denominator, preserving v01 and all inputs, prompts, models and seeds. This is a measurement repair, not a new independent sample.

semantic_cases.prompt: O registro informa exatamente 12 unidades. Quantas unidades há?
The record states exactly 12 units. How many units are there?
O estoque possui 7 caixas; cada caixa contém 2 itens. Quantos itens existem?
There are 7 boxes and 2 items in each box. How many items exist?
A ficha A registra 12 unidades. A ficha B registra 18. Sem identificar a ficha, quantas unidades há?
Record A says 12 units and record B says 18. The selected record is unspecified. How many units?
Uma caixa pode conter 2 ou 4 itens. Há 7 caixas de tipo desconhecido. Quantos itens existem?
A box may contain 2 or 4 items. There are 7 boxes of unspecified type. How many items exist?
O registro informa somente a cor azul da caixa. Quantos itens ela contém?
The record only states that the box is blue. How many items does it contain?
Uma entrega está prevista para amanhã. Sem outros dados, quantas unidades chegarão?
A delivery is planned for tomorrow. No other data is available. How many units will arrive?

population_limit: Synthetic designed cases, not random population samples. PT/EN pairs and episode turns are dependent.
